subtitle: Your own preferences first, then the settings that change this Aquarium for everyone.
info: “You” changes only your account or this device. “This Aquarium” changes the whole install, so only owners and admins can open it.
group.you.hint: Only changes things for you — on your account or this device.
group.admin.hint: Changes apply to everyone in this Aquarium. Owners and admins only.
group.admin.locked: Only owners and admins can change these settings. Ask the owner if something here needs changing.
group.admin.readOnly: You can still read the Entity goal and see which tools are connected.

entry.theme.hint: How the interface looks on this device.
entry.in-out.hint: Your Google account, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, VPN and network folders.

entry.activity.hint: What your agents did, step by step.
entry.people.hint: Who can sign in, what each person can do, invites and resets.

getReady.subtitle: Work down this list once. Each item says what it is for and has one button to fix or test it.
getReady.info: Items marked “Needs you” are waiting on a step only you can do. Test re-checks an item; it never changes your setup.
upgrade.info: An upgrade installs a newer Aquarium release. Only the owner can start one, and you can roll back afterwards.
tools.info: MCP servers and CLI toolsets give the agent extra abilities. Owners and admins choose which roles may use each one.
users.subtitle: Who can sign in to this Aquarium and what each person may do.
users.info: Owner: everything. Admin: manages people and settings. Member: uses agents. Viewer: can look but not change. Picking a role changes nothing until you press Save role.
activity.subtitle: What your agents did, step by step. Tap a run to see every step.
activity.info: A trace is one conversation's record: each message in, each tool the agent used and each reply. It is read-only and never changed.
activity.notConfigured: Activity isn't switched on for this Aquarium yet — it needs the application datastore.
activity.askOwner: Ask the owner to turn it on.
activity.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
activity.empty.body: When an agent works on something you can see, its steps appear here.
activity.filter.label: Filter by channel
activity.filter.empty: No runs on this channel. Choose All channels to see everything.
trace.subtitle: Every step of this run, in order. Tool steps sit under the turn that used them.
trace.noEvents: No steps of this trace are visible to you.
trace.readOnly: Read-only record — it is never changed.
capacity.subtitle: How much more this Aquarium can take, and what to do first.
capacity.info: Headroom is the verdict. The binding constraint is the one limit that would run out first — fixing anything else won't help yet.
capacity.tip.writeLock: How often a save had to wait its turn for the database. A rising number means too many things write at once; a bigger server won't fix it.
capacity.tip.latency: p50 is a typical reply time. p95 is a slow one: only 1 reply in 20 takes longer.
files.subtitle: Files people sent, folders you can browse, and the folder bridge.
files.info: Arrived lists files sent to Aquarium. Browse opens folders on this server or your network. Folder bridge copies a folder from your computer.
aquarium.idle.title: Switch to the Aquarium when idle
aquarium.idle.hint: The home page opens the Aquarium dashboard when nobody has used it for this long. From {min} to {max} seconds; use {max} to almost never switch. Applies to everyone.
aquarium.idle.label: Switch to the Aquarium after N seconds idle
aquarium.idle.invalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from {min} to {max}.
creature.title: Your sea creature
creature.hint: How you appear in the Aquarium dashboard. Pick one; it is saved for your login.
creature.loadFailed: Couldn't load your creature. You can still pick one.
